description: Issue a Lightning invoice to add sats to the prepaid BitFeed balance (minimum 100). Pay the invoice, then call again or GET the check_url to credit the account. Feeds paused for zero balance resume automatically after credit.

bitfeed_token.description: BitFeed account token (btf_…). Also accepted as Authorization: Bearer. Omit on the first create_feed to open an account; the token is returned once.

payment_hash.description: Optional. If set, check this invoice instead of creating one.

name: topup
title: BitFeed Lightning top-up
